{{Quote|Chronologically, I should start with the moment I was activated... centuries ago... on the planet Affa&mdash;|C-3PO|<ref name="The Constancia Affair">"[[The Constancia Affair]]"</ref>}}
'''Affa''' was a heavily mechanized [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Affa system/Legends|Affa system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].

==History==
The area around Affa was explored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Affa was host to a [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] manufacturing plant, one which produced many components which would be used in the construction of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], almost a century before his activation on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Affa first appeared in notes [[George Lucas]] composed in [[1977]] when creating a backstory for C-3PO intended for the use of licensees in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. It was where the droid was first built, in [[112 BBY]]. It is described as being in the "Third Sector" of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in the [[Outland Regions]] (Outer Rim).<ref name="The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>
